title: Gobble Grid
description: Nib is starving and the garden is full of seeds. Clear every row before the Glooms catch you, grab a chili to turn the tables, and slip through the side tunnels when it gets tight. Every board clear speeds things up.
instructions: Arrow keys or WASD to steer (swipe on touch). Eat every seed to clear the board. Chilis make Glooms edible for a few seconds. P to pause, M to mute.
